name: K-EndangeredBench
description: Record set pairing Korean national endangered-species designations (Class I/II under Annex 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act, as amended 2022-12-09) with IUCN Red List categories, GBIF taxonomic and occurrence facts, and BonV Lab ecology-card narratives, for measuring factual accuracy and hallucination in AI-generated science education content. Includes the 282-taxon statutory census in the same schema. Version 1.0.9 keeps the record values of v1.0.6 to v1.0.8. It states the behaviour of the IUCN country-list endpoint as observed rather than inferred, narrows the statement on current Phoxinus assessments to what was checked, identifies the Catalogue of Life release behind the Dryophytes suweonensis synonymy (Annual Checklist 2023, DOI 10.48580/dfsr), corrects the geographic wording of the Dryophytes relation, removes an internal enumeration value and a duplicated assessment from iucn_derived.json (with packaging checks for both), revises the Korean guide and the IUCN value check script.
